scripts.build:web: npm --prefix web clean-install --progress=false && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.build: npm run build:web && cargo install -q worker-build --version 0.8.6 && worker-build --release
scripts.test: cargo test && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --all-targets -- -D warnings
